prompt: I need to reconfigure the design-engineer plugin. We switched from Figma to Sketch and added two more team members. Can you re-run the setup?

assertions.text: Detects existing configuration and acknowledges it
Offers choice to reconfigure vs view vs cancel (not just overwriting)
Produces updated config reflecting Sketch and 3 team members
Preserves existing deliverables and project state during reconfiguration
Shows summary of what changed between old and new config
